Meet your artist

Care in every detail.

“Beauty isn’t about changing who you are. It’s the confidence of seeing your own features at their best.”

Nisha Shah is a licensed esthetician and threading specialist with a precise eye and a gentle hand. For more than a decade, she has refined her craft across brows, lashes, tinting, facials and waxing.

Her approach is personal: listen first, study the face, then create a result that feels natural to the person wearing it. Whether it is your first brow appointment or your monthly ritual, you can expect calm care, honest guidance and no rushed work.

Nisha S. — Founder & Artist

Protect your results

The aftercare edit.

A little care in the first 24–48 hours helps your brows and lashes stay beautifully set for longer.

Avoid steam, swimming, saunas, heavy workouts and direct water on freshly laminated brows or lifted lashes.

Keep retinol, exfoliating acids and oil-rich cleansers away from the treatment area for several days, especially after threading or tinting.

Use a clean spoolie to guide brow hairs and lifted lashes back into place—no tugging, just light upward strokes.

After the initial dry window, follow Nisha’s recommended conditioning routine and avoid excessive rubbing or heat.

Good to know

Your questions, answered.

Arrive with the brow area clean if possible, and allow two to three weeks of growth before a full reshaping. Share any recent peels, retinoid use or skin sensitivity before treatment.

Most lash lifts last about six to eight weeks, depending on your natural lash cycle and aftercare.

Threading removes hair without applying wax or chemical depilatories to the skin, so many sensitive clients prefer it. Nisha will review your skin and routine first.

Yes. Popular pairings include brow lamination with tint and shaping, or a lash lift with tint. Call the studio to plan enough time for your ideal combination.
